name: py-callers
purpose: Find every place a Python function, method or class is defined, called, imported or referenced across the worktree, each with its file, line, enclosing function and code, so you know what a change to it breaks.
examples: find every call site of parse
what breaks if I change the signature of load
find the usages of a class before renaming it
